metadata.Name: JaLeCoN
metadata.Description: The first Japanese dataset for lexical complexity prediction (LCP) with separate complexity scores for Chinese/Korean annotators and others.
Provider: Nara Institute of Science and Technology
metadata.Paper Title: Japanese Lexical Complexity for Non-Native Readers: A New Dataset
metadata.Venue Title: Proceedings of the 61st Annual Meeting of the Association for Computational Linguistics (Volume 1: Long Papers)
Affiliations: Nara Institute of Science and Technology
metadata.Abstract: Lexical complexity prediction (LCP) is the task of predicting the complexity of words in a text on a continuous scale. To study lexical complexity in Japanese, we construct the first Japanese LCP dataset, JaLeCoN, which provides separate complexity scores for Chinese/Korean annotators and others. In the baseline experiment, we demonstrate the effectiveness of a BERT-based system for Japanese LCP.
